_comment: symbols.c do_symset(TRUE): a human Priest with symset:DECgraphics level-teleports to the Sokoban entry level, whose walls DECgraphics colours blue through G_*_sokoban customizations. From #optionsfull he picks roguesymset and chooses 'plain'. do_symset() calls clear_symsetentry(ROGUESET), whose clear_all_glyphmap_colors() drops every glyph's custom colour, reads the file directly with read_sym_file(), and reapplies only the rogue set's (empty) customizations, so the redrawn Sokoban walls lose their blue. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
